paragraphs.source_en: You shall be free indeed when your days are not without a care nor your nights without a want and a grief,

units.source_en: You shall be free indeed when your days are not without a care nor your nights without a want and a grief,

paragraphs.source_en: But rather when these things girdle your life and yet you rise above them naked and unbound.

units.source_en: But rather when these things girdle your life and yet you rise above them naked and unbound.

ja.t: むしろ、それらのものがあなたがたの
いていても、あなたがたが

paragraphs.source_en: And how shall you rise beyond your days and nights unless you break the chains which you at the dawn of your understanding have fastened around your noon hour?

units.source_en: And how shall you rise beyond your days and nights unless you break the chains which you at the dawn of your understanding have fastened around your noon hour?

ja.t: がることができようか。

paragraphs.source_en: In truth that which you call freedom is the strongest of these chains, though its links glitter in the sun and dazzle your eyes.

units.source_en: In truth that which you call freedom is the strongest of these chains, though its links glitter in the sun and dazzle your eyes.

ja.t: まことに、あなたがたが
できらめき、あなたがたの
をくらませるけれども。

paragraphs.source_en: And what is it but fragments of your own self you would discard that you may become free?

units.source_en: And what is it but fragments of your own self you would discard that you may become free?

ja.t: ろうとしているものは、いったい
だろう。それはあなたがた
にほかならないのではないか。

paragraphs.source_en: If it is an unjust law you would abolish, that law was written with your own hand upon your own forehead.

units.source_en: If it is an unjust law you would abolish, that law was written with your own hand upon your own forehead.

ja.t: そうとしているものが

paragraphs.source_en: You cannot erase it by burning your law books nor by washing the foreheads of your judges, though you pour the sea upon them.

units.source_en: You cannot erase it by burning your law books nor by washing the foreheads of your judges, though you pour the sea upon them.

paragraphs.source_en: And if it is a despot you would dethrone, see first that his throne erected within you is destroyed.

units.source_en: And if it is a despot you would dethrone, see first that his throne erected within you is destroyed.

ja.t: ろそうとしているものが
であるなら、まず、あなたがたの

paragraphs.source_en: For how can a tyrant rule the free and the proud, but for a tyranny in their own freedom and a shame in their own pride?

units.source_en: For how can a tyrant rule the free and the proud, but for a tyranny in their own freedom and a shame in their own pride?

paragraphs.source_en: And if it is a care you would cast off, that cart has been chosen by you rather than imposed upon you.

units.source_en: And if it is a care you would cast off, that cart has been chosen by you rather than imposed upon you.

ja.t: てようとしているものが
しつけられたものではなく、あなたがた

paragraphs.source_en: And if it is a fear you would dispel, the seat of that fear is in your heart and not in the hand of the feared.

units.source_en: And if it is a fear you would dispel, the seat of that fear is in your heart and not in the hand of the feared.

ja.t: おうとしているものが

paragraphs.source_en: Verily all things move within your being in constant half embrace, the desired and the dreaded, the repugnant and the cherished, the pursued and that which you would escape.

units.source_en: Verily all things move within your being in constant half embrace, the desired and the dreaded, the repugnant and the cherished, the pursued and that which you would escape.

ja.t: まことに、すべてのものはあなたがたの

paragraphs.source_en: And when the shadow fades and is no more, the light that lingers becomes a shadow to another light.

units.source_en: And when the shadow fades and is no more, the light that lingers becomes a shadow to another light.

ja.t: れ、もはやなくなるとき、あとに

paragraphs.source_en: And thus your freedom when it loses its fetters becomes itself the fetter of a greater freedom.

units.source_en: And thus your freedom when it loses its fetters becomes itself the fetter of a greater freedom.

ja.t: そのように、あなたがたの

paragraphs.source_en: Your soul is oftentimes a battlefield, upon which your reason and your judgment wage war against your passion and your appetite.

units.source_en: Your soul is oftentimes a battlefield, upon which your reason and your judgment wage war against your passion and your appetite.
